title: Local lifting families detect zero maps with Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be a qcqs scheme and A a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let p:F→G be an epimorphism of A-valued small-etale sheaves, W a qcqs object of the small etale site, B,T objects of A, x:B→G(W), and g:B→T. Suppose that for every source map π:B′→B and every covering sieve R on W, if for every f:Z→W in R the map πx restricted to Z lifts through p(Z), then πg=0. Then g=0. No compatibility of the local lifts is required and no fixed source object is assumed projective.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 1, local lifting for the hypercover computation; Stacks Tags 00WL and 01H0

proof.text: Construct the canonical local image and its qcqs extension. The presheaf qcqsLocalImagePresheaf(p) has a monic natural inclusion in G and p factors through it by toQcqsLocalImage.
The qcqs extension is a sheaf, using finite-cover descent and finite affine refinements on each qcqs test object. It is therefore a subsheaf of G.

Because p is epic, its factorization through the subsheaf makes the inclusion epic. It is also monic, so the abelian sheaf category makes it an isomorphism. At qcqs W its subobject equals localImage(p,W), hence that local image is top.

Since localImage(p,W)=top, x factors through it. Apply local-image detection with the given hkill to conclude g=0. No map out of an arbitrary coefficient object is required to factor through one stage of a directed union.

proof_origin.place: Categorical local-image proof following Stacks Tags 00WL and 079A. Finite-cover descent is proved by source-refinement induction; sheafhood is proved using finite affine refinements on qcqs test objects, instead of the planned finite matching-kernel argument. Every helper is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_locally_liftable_maps
    {F G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A} (p : F ⟶ G) [Epi p]
    (W : X.Etale) [CompactSpace W.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W.left]
    (B T : A) (x : B ⟶ G.obj.obj (op W)) (g : B ⟶ T)
    (hkill : ∀ (B' : A) (π : B' ⟶ B) (R : Sieve W), R ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W →
      (∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), R f →
        ∃ l : B' ⟶ F.obj.obj (op Z), l ≫ p.hom.app (op Z) = π ≫ x ≫ G.obj.map f.op) →
      π ≫ g = 0) : g = 0
